scripts.build:chrome: npm run build:with-ui && cp manifest.json dist/manifest.json && cp -r icons dist/
scripts.build:firefox: npm run build:with-ui && cp manifest.firefox.json dist/manifest.json && cp -r icons dist/
scripts.build:safari: npm run build:with-ui && cp manifest.safari.json dist/manifest.json && cp -r icons dist/ && xcrun safari-web-extension-converter dist --app-name WindowLLM --bundle-identifier org.windowllm.WindowLLM --swift --macos-only --no-prompt --no-open --force --project-location safari-project && xcodebuild -project safari-project/WindowLLM/WindowLLM.xcodeproj -scheme WindowLLM -configuration Release build CONFIGURATION_BUILD_DIR=../build
scripts.build:safari:web: npm run build:with-ui && cp manifest.safari.json dist/manifest.json && cp -r icons dist/
